newsitem.title: CANADA: AGF intends normal course issuer bid.
newsitem.headline: AGF intends normal course issuer bid.

text.p: AGF Management Ltd said on Monday it notified the Toronto Stock Exchange that it intended to make a normal course issuer bid for the purchase for cancellation of some of its Class B non-voting shares.
AGF said the purchases would be made from February 5, 1997 to February 4, 1998.

The shares may not be purchased by AGF at a price that exceeded by more than 15 percent the weighted average price at which the shares traded in the 10 trading days before the date of the purchase, AGF said.
It said it would not purchase more than 10 percent or 1,028,231 class B share public float. AGF said the public float at January 30 was 10,282,312 class B shares.
Under the current normal course issuer bid that expired on January 30, 20,000 Class B shares were purchased at an average price of C$33 a share by AGF.
